reducer.inputs: workflow file as the pipeline selects it; API job name; mat_k from job.generate_input_file; completed steps rebuilt from the original CI log (Set up job, executed steps named as the API names them, Complete job; post-steps omitted)

gwa.gwa_v2: repository gwa.py with Static Condition Resolution (conditions static)
gwa.inputs: workflow, repository, API job (name, labels) and run (event, branch, pull requests); never the CI log

mapping.equivalent_renderings: as written; matrix-rendered; literal env substituted; scalars compared as strings; full-line shell comments ignored

ground_truth.alignment: order-preserving, maximising header scores (3 exact, 2 literal prefix, 1 fuzzy >= 0.8); uncertain if an unconditional step is unmatched before the last match (or anywhere in a successful job), or a header fits an executed and an unexecuted step equally
